requests.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a new sibling inventory icon for the Trætoppen painted storybook game. Paint one small hand-tied bouquet: three cream wildflower blossoms and one pale blue-white moonflower, sage leaves, stems bundled with a muted rose cloth ribbon and a tiny plain heart-shaped paper seal. Only the object, no holder or hands. No text, letters, numbers, logo, UI frame, rarity border, background, cast shadow, emitted aura, plastic gloss, vector geometry, photorealism or neon. Save as a new asset; the existing wildflower is the visual basis, not a file to overwrite.
